draft.subject: Re: Dark mode — and getting Maple Collective's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for the note on dark mode, and glad things have felt good so far. On your open ticket: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap — I'll keep you posted as that moves.

In the meantime, the one thing that tends to make week one useful is getting a real project in place. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
